premise: Through the long night the printer works on under the floodlights while the base sleeps, the excavator brings soil and the seismometer listens to the steady hum — and at daybreak there's a new wall.
inspiration: Grimm's 'The Elves and the Shoemaker', where helpers work by night while everyone sleeps, turned: the night workers are machines, and the wall is for everyone.
lesson: Steady work, a little at a time, builds big things.

en-US.title: The Night Shift
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall} The long Moon night had come, and the crew were fast asleep. {all:face sleeping} Well, nearly everyone was. {canvas:floodlights} Out on the plain, the floodlights clicked on, and the night shift began. {sfx:clunk} The {printer:enter} printer unfolded its long legs, {printer:sparks 0.4} and its motors started up. The {excavator:enter} excavator trundled over {excavator:go to printer} with a full scoop. {printer:live hold} Back and forth, back and forth went the printer, laying the wall one layer at a time. {sfx:whirr} {excavator:live} The excavator dug another scoop. {printer:shake 0.3} And another layer went down. Nearby, the {seismometer:enter} seismometer listened. {seismometer:live} Its little light blinked in time with the work: whirr… blink… whirr… blink… [softly] Like a lullaby, humming through the ground. {excavator:pulse} All night long. {canvas:daybreak} Then at last, white sunlight came sweeping over the ridge. {all:face happy} {printer:live resume} There stood a brand-new wall, strong and grey. {all:hop} Everyone cheered. [playfully] {printer:sparkle} And the night shift? It had a well-earned rest.

es-ES.title: El turno de noche
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall} Había llegado la larga noche lunar, y la tripulación dormía profundamente. {all:face sleeping} Bueno, casi todos. {canvas:floodlights} En la llanura se encendieron los focos, y empezó el turno de noche. {sfx:clunk} La {printer:enter} impresora desplegó sus largas patas, {printer:sparks 0.4} y sus motores arrancaron. La {excavator:enter} excavadora llegó traqueteando {excavator:go to printer} con la pala llena. {printer:live hold} La impresora iba y venía, iba y venía, levantando el muro capa a capa. {sfx:whirr} {excavator:live} La excavadora recogió otra palada. {printer:shake 0.3} Y bajó otra capa. Cerca de allí, el {seismometer:enter} sismómetro escuchaba. {seismometer:live} Su lucecita parpadeaba al ritmo del trabajo: zzzum… parpadeo… zzzum… parpadeo… [softly] Como una nana, vibrando por el suelo. {excavator:pulse} Toda la noche. {canvas:daybreak} Por fin, la luz blanca del sol asomó por las montañas. {all:face happy} {printer:live resume} Allí había un muro nuevo, fuerte y gris. {all:hop} Todos lo celebraron. [playfully] {printer:sparkle} ¿Y el turno de noche? Se ganó un buen descanso.

clunk.prompt: big lamps switching on with a soft deep clunk, then a faint electric hum

whirr.prompt: a small machine's motor whirring smoothly back and forth, gentle, slow and steady, like a lullaby
